sloka: दशग्रीवस्तु तं जित्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः ।आरुह्य पुष्पकं भूयो निष्क्रान्तो यमसादनात् ।। ७.२२.५० ॥
transliteration: daśagrīvastu taṁ jitvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ ।āruhya puṣpakaṁ bhūyo niṣkrānto yamasādanāt ।। 7.22.50 ॥

translations.english: Having said, "Therefore, I disappear from the sight of this demon," he vanished right there with his chariot and horses.
